advice.replySubject: Lakeshore Dental Group workers compensation: a few items before we quote
advice.replyBody:
Hi Marguerite,

Thank you for sending the workers compensation submission for Lakeshore Dental Group. We are glad to look at this alongside the property and general liability we already write.

Before we can send a quote, could you help with the following:

1. Claims: the application and your email say three claims, all closed, but the Quillhaven Mutual loss run shows four claims with one still open. Please confirm the correct count and status, and correct the application if needed.
2. Open claim: a status update on the Jun 2, 2025 hygienist shoulder strain, including the return to work outlook.
3. Lincoln Park office: estimated payroll and job split for the roughly six new hires, and the planned opening date.
4. Drug-free workplace: the application has neither box checked. Please confirm Yes or No.
5. Signed application: the applicant statement is unsigned, with name, title and date blank.
6. Loss run: an update past Sep 30, 2026, or confirmation of no new claims since then.

If we can have these well ahead of your Oct 20, 2026 deadline, that will give us the best chance to turn it around in time.

Thanks again,
Demo User
Antsurance

issues.title: Claim count and status disagree
issues.detail: The Application says 3 claims in three years and the Broker's email says three claims, all closed. The Loss run (valued Sep 30, 2026) shows 4 claims, 1 open, $26,650 paid, $6,500 reserved, $33,150 total incurred. Four or more claims would refer the quote to an underwriter.
issues.ask: Confirm the claim count and status, and correct the application if the loss run is right.

issues.title: Open lost time claim
issues.detail: The Loss run shows a Jun 2, 2025 hygienist repetitive shoulder strain, lost time, treatment continuing, $14,300 paid and $6,500 reserved. The Application says there is no return-to-work program.
issues.ask: Ask for a status update on the open shoulder claim, including return to work outlook.

issues.title: Fourth office within the term
issues.detail: The Broker's email says a Lincoln Park office opens January 2027 adding about six people, and their payroll is not in the $1,530,000 on the Application. Payroll also grew from $1,402,000 to an estimated $1,530,000 on the Loss run.
issues.ask: Ask for estimated payroll and class split for the Lincoln Park hires, and the opening date.

issues.title: Drug-free workplace unanswered
issues.detail: The Application has neither Yes nor No checked for drug-free workplace, and no other document answers it.
issues.ask: Confirm whether they have a drug-free workplace program.

issues.title: Application unsigned
issues.detail: The applicant statement on the Application is not signed, and the name, title and date are blank.
issues.ask: Send a signed and dated application.

issues.title: Headcount differs from record
issues.detail: The Application lists 24 employees (20 full time, 4 part time); Antsurance holds 22.

issues.title: Loss run partial year
issues.detail: The Loss run is valued Sep 30, 2026, so Oct and Nov 2026 of the current Quillhaven Mutual year are not shown.
issues.ask: Send an updated loss run closer to the Dec 1, 2026 effective date, or confirm no new claims since Sep 30, 2026.
